# rails-onboarding-engine

> Multi-step onboarding flow engine with a declarative step DSL, conditional branches, progress percentages, versioned migrations and HMAC-signed resume tokens Gem `u953-rails-onboarding-engine`, module `Trysac::RailsOnboardingEngine`, MIT licensed, Ruby >= 4.0,
> standard library only.
